2105-4598-6965-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-6965-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-6965-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2393-3025-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-3025-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2178-2380-4050.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-4050.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Repeat.

2534-3817-3899-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1865-2232-7827-7836.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
1865-2232-7827-7836.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

1778-2459-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-2459-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3276-3967-5038-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat as needed.

560-2558-6737-6798.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

2308-4476-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4476-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Answered Prayers triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

372-864-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-864-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-4927-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5414-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-3490-4050-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-4268.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2061-5733-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-5733-6991.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

339-677-1251-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-5686-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-5686-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-2421-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

338-1874-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1874-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-5742-5743-6753.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

465-618-2438.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1785-2534-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Coercive Recruiter.
1785-2534-5003.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, adding an amount of {B} equal to Coercive Recruiter's mana value.
When Coercive Recruiter dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.

1785-4730-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Sparring Mummy.
1785-4730-5003.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, adding an amount of {B} equal to Sparring Mummy's mana value.
When Sparring Mummy dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5173-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Shambing Ghast's power.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4365-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4365-4559-4740-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1545-2308-2440.manaNeeded: {2}, plus an additional {1} available if you do not control a Fungus or Beast
1545-2308-2440.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2308-2440.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Fungus and/or Beast you control.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to the Fungus Beast's toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

1216-1799-2034-2048.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {C}{C}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1373-1993-3470-4482.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control fewer than nine lands.
224-1373-1993-3470-4482.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to either tap or untap a creature, or scry 1.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

1479-3703-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
